source: OpenStreetMap original API data; independently assembled by Folded City
terrain: AWS Open Data Terrain Tiles, Terrarium encoding, SRTM 30m based; 5m resampled display grid; not surveyed elevations
building_heights: OSM heights where present; otherwise 4m per level or 16m fallback, explicitly estimated
trees_and_facades: illustrative trees; reference-informed procedural facade palettes for student union, library and new engineering; other facades neutral and unverified; not photographic reconstruction
building_label_overrides: campus-data.js/applyCampusLabels adds the missing Veterinary Medicine building name and search aliases from official university guidance; OSM source records and geometry remain unchanged
display_terrain: runtime-only upper-envelope slope limit 0.35 m/m with continuous mesh and lake shoreline constraints; original DEM grid preserved; not surveyed terrain and not used for routing
display_building_base: background building base lowered where needed to meet display terrain; student union registration datum unchanged; source building records preserved
coordinate_frame: WGS84 ECEF/ENU into common local metre coordinates, scale 1; original indoor mesh unchanged
registration: existing coarse GNSS placement plus existing 2m east / -2m north preview offset; not surveyed
routing: background is not walkability evidence; indoor routes remain in independent navigation.json
